properties.entry: SELECT G.GROUP_NUM, G.GROUP_NAME, G.GROUP_DESC, G.GROUP_TYPE, G.GROUP_OWNER_NUM, TO_CHAR(G.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GROUP_MEMBERS WHERE GROUP_NUM = G.GROUP_NUM AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'A') AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM GROUPS G JOIN GROUP_MEMBERS GM ON G.GROUP_NUM = GM.GROUP_NUM WHERE GM.USER_NUM = ? AND GM.MEMBER_STATUS = 'A' AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY GM.JOIN_DATE DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GROUP_MEMBERS WHERE USER_NUM = ? AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'A'
SELECT SEQ_GROUPS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO GROUPS (GROUP_NUM, GROUP_NAME, GROUP_DESC, GROUP_TYPE, GROUP_OWNER_NUM, GROUP_OPEN_YN, SETTLE_USE_YN, USE_YN, CREATED_AT) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'Y', 'Y', SYSDATE)
INSERT INTO GROUP_MEMBERS (MEMBER_NUM, GROUP_NUM, USER_NUM, JOIN_DATE, MEMBER_STATUS) VALUES (SEQ_GROUP_MEMBERS.NEXTVAL, ?, ?, SYSDATE, 'A')
UPDATE GROUPS SET GROUP_NAME = ?, GROUP_DESC = ?, GROUP_OPEN_YN = ? WHERE GROUP_NUM = ? AND GROUP_OWNER_NUM = ?
SELECT * FROM GROUPS WHERE GROUP_NUM = ?
UPDATE GROUPS SET USE_YN = 'N' WHERE GROUP_NUM = ? AND GROUP_OWNER_NUM = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GROUP_MEMBERS WHERE GROUP_NUM = ? AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'A'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GROUP_MEMBERS WHERE GROUP_NUM = ? AND USER_NUM = ? AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'A'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INVITATIONS WHERE GROUP_NUM = ? AND INVITEE_NUM = ? AND INVITE_STATUS = 'P'
INSERT INTO INVITATIONS (INVITE_NUM, GROUP_NUM, INVITER_NUM, INVITEE_NUM, INVITE_STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_INVITATIONS.NEXTVAL, ?, ?, ?, 'P', SYSDATE)

SELECT M.MEMBER_NUM, M.GROUP_NUM, M.USER_NUM, TO_CHAR(M.JOIN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS JOIN_DATE, M.MEMBER_STATUS, U.USER_ID, U.USER_NICKNAME FROM GROUP_MEMBERS M JOIN USERS U ON M.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM JOIN GROUPS G ON M.GROUP_NUM = G.GROUP_NUM WHERE M.GROUP_NUM = ? AND M.MEMBER_STATUS = 'A' ORDER BY CASE WHEN M.USER_NUM = G.GROUP_OWNER_NUM THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, M.JOIN_DATE ASC
UPDATE GROUP_MEMBERS SET MEMBER_STATUS = 'W' WHERE GROUP_NUM = ? AND USER_NUM = ?
SELECT USER_NUM FROM ( SELECT USER_NUM FROM GROUP_MEMBERS WHERE GROUP_NUM = ? AND USER_NUM != ? AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'A' ORDER BY JOIN_DATE ASC, MEMBER_NUM ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
UPDATE GROUPS SET GROUP_OWNER_NUM = ? WHERE GROUP_NUM = ?
SELECT GROUP_NUM, GROUP_NAME, GROUP_DESC FROM GROUPS WHERE GROUP_OPEN_YN = 'Y' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND GROUP_NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' ORDER BY GROUP_NUM DESC

SELECT T.GTRANS_NUM, T.GROUP_NUM, T.TRANS_AMOUNT, TO_CHAR(T.TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRANS_DATE, T.TRANS_MEMO, T.USER_NUM, U.USER_NICKNAME, C.CATEGORY_NAME, LP.PERIOD_STATUS FROM GROUP_TRANSACTIONS T JOIN USERS U ON T.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM JOIN GROUP_CATEGORIES C ON T.GCATEGORY_NUM = C.GCATEGORY_NUM JOIN LEDGER_PERIODS LP ON T.PERIOD_NUM = LP.PERIOD_NUM WHERE T.GROUP_NUM = ? AND TO_CHAR(T.TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') = ? AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY T.TRANS_DATE DESC, T.GTRANS_NUM DESC

SELECT PERIOD_NUM, PERIOD_SEQ, TO_CHAR(PERIOD_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE, TO_CHAR(PERIOD_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE FROM LEDGER_PERIODS WHERE GROUP_NUM = ? AND PERIOD_STATUS = 'C' ORDER BY PERIOD_SEQ DESC

SELECT P.USER_NICKNAME AS PAYER_NICKNAME, R.USER_NICKNAME AS RECEIVER_NICKNAME, S.SETTLE_AMOUNT FROM SETTLEMENT_SNAPSHOTS S JOIN USERS P ON S.PAYER_USER_NUM = P.USER_NUM JOIN USERS R ON S.RECEIVER_USER_NUM = R.USER_NUM WHERE S.PERIOD_NUM = ? ORDER BY S.SETTLE_AMOUNT DESC

SELECT T.GTRANS_NUM, T.TRANS_AMOUNT, TO_CHAR(T.TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRANS_DATE, T.TRANS_MEMO, U.USER_NICKNAME, C.CATEGORY_NAME FROM GROUP_TRANSACTIONS T JOIN USERS U ON T.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM JOIN GROUP_CATEGORIES C ON T.GCATEGORY_NUM = C.GCATEGORY_NUM WHERE T.PERIOD_NUM = ? AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY T.TRANS_DATE DESC, T.GTRANS_NUM DESC
UPDATE GROUPS SET GROUP_NAME = ?, GROUP_DESC = ?, GROUP_OPEN_YN = ?, SETTLE_USE_YN = ? WHERE GROUP_NUM = ? AND GROUP_OWNER_NUM = ?
SELECT GROUP_NUM, GROUP_NAME, GROUP_DESC, GROUP_TYPE, GROUP_OWNER_NUM, GROUP_OPEN_YN, SETTLE_USE_YN, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT FROM GROUPS WHERE GROUP_NUM = ?
